title: 14-BCV-016 - Manufactured structural components in one-family and two-family dwellings
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide, as stated by the STANDATA)
catalogue_status: Catalogue row is not marked [WITHDRAWN]; PDF carries an Archived watermark.

facts.text: The STANDATA applies to one-family/two-family dwellings within the stated Division C professional-involvement exemption and not to traditionally constructed housing using Part 9-prescribed components.

It conditions the path on CCMC evaluation/listing and a permit file containing specified manufacturer/supplier letters, layout schematics, design drawings/calculations and site-specific engineered-column footing design where applicable.
facts.locator: 14-BCV-016 PDF, pp.3-4, CODE REFERENCES and VARIANCE

limitations: This is a provincial regulator-issued STANDATA/standing variance, not an individual application, applicant statement, project drawing, permit record or site-specific decision.
The records address the Alberta Building Code 2014 and, where noted, Alberta Fire Code 2014; do not treat them as proof of applicability under the Alberta 2023 code edition or current law.
